finding.text: `gateOf` runs `spawnSync` once per stale row inside `readyRows()`, which Servex calls on its own event loop (`Servex/Servex.js:697`). I measured one gate check at about 0.7 s, so every list load, and every Merge click (which runs `readyRows` again), freezes all of Servex for about 0.7 s per stale branch. With two stale rows today it is fine. If the list grows, gate only the branch being merged, or use async `spawn` (Server/ReadyToMerge.mjs:27, :76).

`mergeBranch` checks that `opts.head` is the branch head, then runs `merge.mjs <worktree>`, and merge.mjs merges whatever the head is at that moment (Server/ReadyToMerge.mjs:95-99). A commit that lands in between gets merged under the card's sha. merge.mjs runs the review gate again, so nothing unreviewed lands, but the `merged:` log line could name the wrong sha.

The edits outside the fence were needed and are logged in session.jsonl. The Servex.js change fixes a real bug: `/api/merge` sent `res.json(<Promise>)`, so the page got `{}`, and the fix awaits it. `--gate-only` in Server/merge.mjs:176 has no entry in that file's header comment yet; the minion flagged this too.

Since the stale case is now handled, the module header still says the Merge button "refuses" stale rows: Server/ReadyToMerge.mjs:144-145 ("refuses a branch not on the list, stale, or with no worktree"). That comment is now out of date.

Until the merge plus a Servex restart, both stale cards (roles-class, qf-2) will say "Servex's merge.mjs is older than the --gate-only check". That is correct, but the file it means is the main tree's `Server/merge.mjs`, not Servex's own.
